legal.privacySection5P1: We do not share your personal data with third parties except: (a) when required by law, (b) with your explicit consent, (c) with service providers essential to operating the Service (Supabase, Vercel), who are bound by data processing agreements.
legal.privacySection5P2: Souls you choose to share via the sharing feature become publicly accessible via a unique URL. You can delete shared Souls at any time.

legal.privacySection7P1: The Service is not directed at individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately.
legal.privacySection7P2: If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.
legal.privacySection8P1: We may update this Privacy Protocol from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
